permissions.name: read-figure.net.vision
permissions.reason: Send the named image file to the configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (default https://api.deepseek.com) and read back its description. This is the plugin's entire function; the destination is config.baseUrl.

permissions.name: read-figure.fs.read
permissions.reason: Read the image file the caller names, the bundled handoff protocol, and — when an environment variable is absent — the API key from the DSH credentials file. No directory is enumerated.

permissions.name: read-figure.fs.write
permissions.reason: Only when the caller passes outPath or writeHandoff is enabled: write the handoff Markdown into config.handoffDir. Without those the plugin writes nothing.

x-display.title: read-figure
x-display.description: Let a text-only model read a figure: a vision model transcribes the image into a three-part handoff, uncertainty included, before the plain-text model reasons about it.

x-tool-namespaces.source: lib/index.mjs via ctx.tools.register, with prompts/figure-handoff.zh.md as the protocol asset
x-tool-namespaces.shellPermission: No shell. One outbound HTTPS request per call to config.baseUrl, cancellable through exec.signal.
